paragraphs.text: His first concern was to restore religion, which had in Saul's day been corrupted and neglected.

paragraphs.text: That is, from Gibea, where the inhabitants of Kirjathjearim had placed it in the house of Abinadab, 2Sa 6:3.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That is, before the Ark, where God showed himself: so that the sign is taken for the thing signified, which is common to all sacraments both in the old and new testaments.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Before the Ark for usurping that which did not belong to his calling: for this charge was given to the priests, Nu 4:15, so that here all good intentions are condemned, unless they are commanded by the word of God.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Who was a Levite, and called Gittite, because he dwelt at Gath.
